title: omni-evidence/v1 batch
description: The batch.json of an omni-evidence/v1 bundle: the cross-repo interchange that cgap (gate runs) and ash_pplan (execution receipts) emit and affidavit certifies via `affi receipt emit-batch`. Producers never hash; affidavit computes blake3(payload bytes) per event and seals the chain at `affi receipt assemble`. See docs/integrations/OMNIPLATFORM.md.

event_type.description: Dotted producer-namespaced type, e.g. cgap.gate.pass or pplan.execution.succeeded.

items.description: affidavit object ref id:type[:qualifier]. id and type are colon-free; the qualifier may contain colons (raw IRIs, commands).

payload.description: Path to the payload bytes, relative to the directory holding batch.json (absolute and cwd-relative paths are also accepted).
